text:
ana (oncall): FYI postmortem follow-up — yesterday's spike looks like concurrent GPU degradation + autoscaler backfill. p99 for /v1/generate hit ~2100ms for ~45m, throughput down ~30%. Proposing a short-term SLO adjustment + remediation plan. Need owners & timelines.

mike (infra): ack. +1 for a temporary p99 relaxation for 48h while we push fixes. I will throttle canary traffic and enable fallback model pool to reduce customer impact. Patch ETA: 6h for initial deploy.

jamal (serving): also recommend a routing rule to prefer non-degraded regions and a KV cache warmup prior to traffic ramp — avoids thundering cache refresh on failover. I'll own routing rule + validation (ETA 48h).

sara (product): customer impact notes: 12 enterprise customers saw >200% latency on heavy batching jobs. We need to confirm whether SLA windows were missed and prepare comms if so.

deploy-bot: Incident #INC-2026-042 closed by mike (infra) — notes: nodes restarted, partial mitigations active.

ana (oncall): Proposed temporary SLO patch to buy time (48h):
```yaml
service: inference-api
objective:
  p99_latency_ms: 800  # relaxed from 500
  p95_latency_ms: 300
window: 30d
error_budget: 0.02
```
Apply immediately; rollback after verification.

mike (infra): I'll own the emergency SLO rollout + dashboard annotation. Pushing change to slo-config and will add an annotation to the infra dashboard. ETA 1h.

jamal (serving): I'll add dashboard panels for region_failover_ratio and kv_cache_hit_rate, plus two alerts: "p95 > 350ms for 10m" and "region_failover_rate > 5% for 5m". Alert snippet: 
```
alert: HighP95Latency
expr: p95_latency_ms{service="inference-api"} > 350
for: 10m
```

ana (oncall): Action items (owners + due):
- mike (infra): push SLO change + dashboard annotation (due +1h)
- jamal (serving): routing rule + cache warmup + panels/alerts (due 48h)
- sara (product): draft customer note & SLA impact review (due 24h)
- ana (oncall): run 72h regression with traffic replay after fixes (due 72h)

sara (product): I accept owner for customer comms. Will sync legal for SLA wording and recommended outreach.

mike (infra): pushed config PR: https://git.redwood/slo-config/pulls/312 — adding dashboard annotation now :white_check_mark:

jamal (serving): routing change staged in canary; monitoring green so far. Will promote tomorrow after canary window.

ana (oncall): scheduling a follow-up review in 3 days to decide whether to make SLO change permanent or revert. Calendar invite: https://cal.link/3day-slo-review

sara (product): if this is recurring (thundering cache + autoscaler gap), consider shifting some customers to throughput SLOs during burst windows; product wants that conversation in the review.

ana (oncall): noted — will include throughput targets & error-budget burn analysis in the review packet. Closing this thread for now; will update with PR links and timestamps as actions complete. :eyes:
